qualification.details: Senior secondary (10+2) from a recognized board with at least 50% marks and an ITI course of one year or higher duration in the appropriate trade. OR Secondary (10) with at least 60% marks and an ITI Certificate of 2 years duration in the appropriate trade. OR Diploma in Engineering of three years duration in the relevant field from a recognized polytechnic/institute. Essential: Minimum 5 years of experience. Desirable: 10 years of experience. Experience in the area of electrical substation is desirable.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIT Goa Field Technician (Electrical) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIT Goa to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Goa Field Technician (Electrical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the NIT Goa Field Technician (Electrical) position is 21st August 2026. Ensure you complete all formalities before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Technician (Electrical) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have Senior Secondary (10+2) with 50% marks and a 1-year ITI, or Secondary (10) with 60% marks and a 2-year ITI, or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering. Minimum 5 years of experience is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field Technician (Electrical) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Technician (Electrical) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 33,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Field Technician (Electrical) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Field Technician (Electrical) position at the National Institute of Technology Goa.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Technician (Electrical) role involves shortlisting of applications followed by an offline interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Field Technician (Electrical) position at NIT Goa is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q8. Where is NIT Goa located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Goa is located in Cuncolim, Goa, with the pincode 403703.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NITGOA/RECT/CONT/2026/52.

faq.question: Q10. Does NIT Goa offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for this information.
